label: Epistemic authority finite controls (inference)
meaning: Explicit Unit-subject finite frames reusing the existing count/reassurance profiles. They witness that thin F6, presentation and the ordinary-role definition are jointly satisfiable with the goal-relative account, an indifference alternative and the absence of any preference-independent reason, that each premise of the answerability argument can fail while the other holds, and (controls 5 and 6) that each premise of the goal-relative exclusion can fail while the other holds, control 6 with the all-preferences aim also witnessing nonvacuity of the constitutive-aim argument. Analyst interpretations, not actual normative facts or possibility claims.
